verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server lets external AI assistants such as Claude answer natural-language questions over workspace data, for example "Find all my incomplete tasks due this week" and "Generate reports and summaries based on Asana data", using read tools that return workspace content. Native AI (AI Teammates with Work Graph context, Asana Dash as an "AI Chief of Staff") is only described at a marketing level, and nothing shows answers carrying citations to source content. Missing for 10: a documented native in-product AI Q&A experience, citations or source links in answers, evidence that answers are instant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
